name: MobileNAV Configuration Showcase
brief: A reference provider: from three lines to a full device flow.
description: An example consumer of MobileNAV Configuration. One provider, six levels, each a few lines: fields on a stock page, a button with code behind it, lookups, groups, filters and a dynamic layout, a page of your own with a scan wizard, a dialog with your own function codeunit, and profiles, categories, captions and saved filters. Install it, apply it from MobileNAV Configuration, and open the MobileNAV Doctor.
